blind.description: A stylized straight section of brick masonry wall. It consists of warm terracotta/brown-orange stone bricks with bevelled edges, accented by two dark grey/black horizontal trim bands spanning across the width (one near the top and one below the middle). The construction is clean, solid, and fully continuous without cracks, holes, or floating elements.
blind.from_above: A rounded rectangular block divided down the center into two equal rectangular brick caps.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 8 feet tall), and slightly over half as wide as the figure is tall (around 3 to 3.5 feet wide).
